# Introduction

This demonstration report summarizes a \gls{PK} analysis of theophylline
concentrations from the built-in `Theoph` dataset, rendered end to end
through quartifyr's two-pass shell/fill pipeline.

{{< pagebreak >}}

# Results

## Summary Statistics

{{< tbl_caption "Table 1" "Per-subject PK summary statistics" >}}

{rpfy}:pk-summary.csv

Per-subject maximum, minimum, and average observed concentration across
the sampling period.

## Concentration-Time Profile

{{< fig_caption "Figure 1" "Concentration-time profile" >}}

{rpfy}:conc-time.png

Individual concentration-time trajectories for all subjects in the study,
plotted on the same axes.

{{< pagebreak >}}

{{< appendix "StatisticalMethods" "Statistical Methods" >}}

Per-subject summary statistics were computed directly from the observed
concentration-time data; no model-based estimation was performed for this
demonstration report. See {{< appendix_crossref "StatisticalMethods" >}}
for the complete methodology.
